name: Systemia Website Audit
problem: A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.
use_when: why is my website not getting leads
why is my contractor website not ranking
why is my site slow on mobile
find conversion problems on my website
tell me what is wrong with my business website
my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
people visit my site but do not contact me
why is my website not converting
visitors are not turning into leads
inputs: Website/domain. Business name, city, industry and Google Business Profile context improve local and trust checks.
outputs: Observed website findings, deterministic category scores and breakdowns, prioritized audit findings, deeper fix plan/report for paid tier, and remediation scope for Audit + Patch.
pricing: Free preview. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.
confirmation: The free preview creates no payment obligation. Paid tiers require explicit user confirmation before checkout and provider-verified payment before fulfillment.
invocation_status: LIVE on crawlable public host: https://systemia-audit-pro.base44.app/functions/auditAgentGateway with OpenAPI, llms guidance, and remote MCP at https://systemia-audit-pro.base44.app/functions/auditAgentMcp. Agents can inspect $500/$1,200 tiers, prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation, and verified Stripe return automatically queues the supplied website into paid audit intake.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
